mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_PW, MEMBER_NICKNAME, MEMBER_TEL, MEMBER_CARRIER, ENROLL_DATE, MEMBER_DEL_FL FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_EMAIL = #{memberEmail} AND MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_PW, MEMBER_NICKNAME, MEMBER_DEL_FL , MEMBER_TEL , MEMBER_CARRIER ) VALUES ( #{memberEmail}, #{memberPw}, #{memberNickname}, 'N' , #{memberTel} , #{memberCarrier} )
mapper.select: SELECT member_no AS memberNo, member_email AS memberEmail, member_nickname AS memberNickname, member_name AS memberName, member_tel AS memberTel, member_carrier AS memberCarrier, profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, CAST(birth_date AS VARCHAR) AS birthDate, gender, privacy_agree_fl AS privacyAgreeFl, marketing_agree_fl AS marketingAgreeFl FROM member WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} AND member_del_fl = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET member_nickname = #{request.memberNickname}, member_name = #{request.memberName}, profile_image_url = #{request.profileImageUrl}, updated_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}
UPDATE member SET member_pw = #{newPassword}, password_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}

UPDATE member SET member_tel = #{request.memberTel}, member_carrier = #{request.memberCarrier}, birth_date = #{request.birthDate, jdbcType=DATE}, gender = #{request.gender}, privacy_agree_fl = #{request.privacyAgreeFl}, marketing_agree_fl = #{request.marketingAgreeFl}, updated_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}
